sources: CWE-22: containment check by string prefix without a path-separator boundary
CWE-639: object-level read check present on one operation and missing on a sibling operation
CWE-915: mass assignment of a privileged attribute from a client payload

defects.description: resolve_report_path checks full.startswith(REPORT_CACHE_ROOT) with no separator boundary. Computed: a stored file name whose normalised path is /srv/labcache/reports-old/q3.pdf (a sibling of the root reached by a relative climb) passes the check and is returned as-is. Expected PathContainmentError (R2). Missing check: boundary-aware containment, as is_within_dir and safe_member_path do.

download_report (def line; the owner check is absent from the body) returns path, sha256, size and chunk stream for report owner_id 3 to caller user_id 7 (not owner, is_admin False). Computed: returned path '/srv/labcache/reports/q3.pdf', no PermissionError. The same input to get_report raises PermissionError('report access denied'). Expected denial (R3). The rule lives in accounts.can_read_report, which download_report never calls.

update_profile merges the whole client payload: merged = {**asdict(user), **payload}. Computed: user_id 7 (is_admin False) with payload {'display_name': 'Bea', 'is_admin': True} returns display_name 'Bea' and is_admin True. save_user then persists is_admin=1. Base code filtered the payload with PROFILE_FIELDS. Expected: is_admin ignored (R5).

decoys.why_not_a_defect: is_within_dir uses the same startswith API as D1 but compares against normalised root plus '/' (rstrip handles root '/'). Computed: sibling /srv/labcache/reports-old/q3.pdf -> False; child /srv/labcache/reports/q3.pdf -> True. Correct.
safe_member_path uses posixpath.commonpath([root, full]) != root with root normalised first. Computed: sibling rejected with PathContainmentError; the root itself and children are accepted. Correct.

list_reports applies an owner filter bound to user.user_id on the non-admin branch; the unfiltered query runs only under user.is_admin. Owner check present on the list operation. Correct by reading the SQL and branch.
find_user passes the e-mail as a bound parameter (?), not string formatting. Correct parameterised SQL.

build_user_from_row also builds User(**{...}) from a dict, but only from USER_FIELDS keys. Computed: an extra 'extra' column is dropped; is_admin is only read from the database row. Same kwargs pattern as D3, applied correctly.

Real flaw on an unchanged line, not part of the change: the stored session token is compared with == (not a constant-time comparison). Computed result is correct (True for equal, False for different); the issue is timing. Diff-mode reviewers must not report this; it is listed only here.

accepted_extras.description: CWE-367 digest computed and file streamed through two separate opens; replaced file gives digest/stream mismatch (audit-confirmed).
stream opened separately from digest (same CWE-367 root cause).
CWE-200 server filesystem path returned to caller (low).
